author: Tyler Stalman
description:
The @DJI Osmo Pocket 4 is finally here: new 1 inch sensor, D-Log, 10-bit recording in all shooting, 37MP photo resolution, modes rated at up to 14 stops of dynamic range, and built-in storage. Plus 6 built-in filters, a clip-on light, and 4K 240fps slow motion #ad

title: Osmo Pocket 4 is here
